mustFix.problem: Price ranges are shown without the units given in facts.json ('$14–$28', '$60–$120'), so the sample prices misstate the facts
mustFix.fix: Render the facts unit after each range, e.g. '$14–$28 per sq ft', '$60–$120 per face sq ft', in muted mono at 0.85em

elevate.move: Replace the six identical brick tiles with one wall drawn at four ages and scales under raking light: a cement-patched spall close-up, a chimney course at an angle, finished concave joints with a shadow line, and a Cincinnati Italianate facade elevation for the break band, so the illustrations work as the page's photography

Make the mortar course the page grid: every section sits on a full-width drawn joint, the process cross-section scales to the full container so the pin fills its band, and the about and services columns anchor to that course instead of floating beside small tiles
